evidence_level: live local Phoenix vendor diagnostic with source-audited semantics
scope: one verify launch and one 1 GiB copy selftest; not dense compute or R5 workloads

verify.interpretation: launch/wait smoke only; source unconditionally overwrites catch status with PASSED

df_bw.reported_label: Average bandwidth per shim DMA, GS/s
df_bw.interpretable_payload_rate_unit: GiB per host second (one direction); not actual AXI rate or Gsample/s
df_bw.numeric_contract: 268435456 int32 values compared exactly after output sync; values generated by host rand()%4096
df_bw.actual_traffic_unknown_reason: no accepted/completed bus transaction or padding/beat counter collected
df_bw.input_hash_unknown_reason: vendor does not export initialized BO data/hash
df_bw.counter_unknown_reason: not exposed or configured by this vendor test

frequency.limits: single after-run report; not certified clock sample, DVFS/thermal state or stable run frequency

power.reason: report has no sensor and source provenance/meaning must be checked; never use this field for PPA

binary_hash_capture: post-run inventory hashes; E0 did not freeze pre-run payload or address map

measurement_gate.decision: REFINE measurement/kernel access; do not infer no residual or propose dynamic mechanism
